correctness.rationale: For every odd prime p and t∈(0,1/2), self-similar triangular digit mask M=1−2t+t exp(−2πim/p^j)+t exp(−2πin/p^j), and the Fourier product converges normally away from zero factors at integer frequency. A real negative sum of two odd-order unit roots forces conjugate pair u,u¯, hence n≡−m mod p^j and weight τ_{p;k,a}=1/[2(1−cos(2πa/p^k))] with primitive a in (p^k/4,p^k/2). Each frequency vanishes at exactly one j since its p-adic coordinate valuation is j−k. Disjoint cylinder density Σ_{j≥k}2/p^{2j}=2/[p^{2(k−1)}(p²−1)], tail bounded by higher p-divisibility. Congruence reduction yields laminar inclusion iff b≡±a mod p^k; otherwise disjoint, so periodized convolution kernels nested or orthogonal. Conductor escape proves Thomae continuity at nonexceptional weights and discontinuity at countably dense exceptional weights. Independent exact residue enumeration p=5,k=1,a=2 at L=1,2,3 yielded 2,52,1302 matching formula.
